svg.aria-label: Ingestion pipeline: discover files, inventory and hash them, deduplicate, extract text, cache it, link versions, record artifacts.
svg.title: Ingestion pipeline: discover files, inventory and hash them, deduplicate, extract text, cache it, link versions, record artifacts.
svg.text: No model involved. Hashing, parsing and bookkeeping, idempotent: run it twice and nothing changes.
